text:
asha: Quick heads-up — Cinder onboarding next Tue. They want Dedicated pool live + autoscale enabled by EOD Monday. Can we finalise quota and a priming/loadplan?

luis: Got it. Do we have their expected QPS profile? I remember they said a steady 40rps with 300-token avg and weekly spikes to 120rps for campaign bursts.

asha: Yup — that's the ask. Also they care about tail latency <150ms for 95th. Renewal in 10 months; we want a smooth first 90 days.

priya: For autoscale, suggest target utilization 65% with soft burst to 85% for up to 10m. That keeps burst headroom. Also enable prefix KV caching for common prompts.

luis: Agreed on 65%. We should reserve warmup tokens during deployment to avoid cold-start p99 hits. Plan: 10M warmup tokens over the first 2 hours after cutover.

asha: Noted. Tom — can you confirm customer agreed to warmup quota and that billing is covered?

tom: Confirmed with Cinder procurement. They'll accept a one-time warmup credit; legal ok.

priya: Loadtest proposal: two-phase. 1) smoke: 20rps sustained 30m to validate routing + model variant fallback. 2) soak: ramp 40 -> 120rps over 90m with 15m plateau at peak. Capture cpu/gpu util, KV hit-rate, token/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies.

luis: I can run the soak from our k6 harness. Script snippet below:

```
// k6 pseudo-config
stages: [ {duration: '10m', target: 40}, {duration: '80m', target: 120}, {duration: '15m', target: 120}, {duration: '5m', target: 0} ]
vus: 200
payload: {avg_tokens:300}
```

asha: Nice. Can we add a warmup phase to seed KV cache before stage 1? 5m at 15rps should do it.

priya: Yep — add preflight 5m@15rps and a short chaos window where we simulate one model-variant failing (to validate fallback).

luis: I'll include the variant-fail in a 2m cut at 60m into soak. We'll verify fallback latency and no request loss.

deploy-bot: loadtest-scheduler: Loadtest job created -> https://ci.internal/loadtests/1713344556-cinder-soak (runs Mon 23:00 UTC) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

asha: Owners: luis (loadtest run + logs), priya (SRE metrics + fallback validation), tom (customer comms + billing). I'll own the warmup quota sign-off and postmortem.

luis: I'll post the aggregated metrics (csv + grafana link) to this thread within 1h of completion.

priya: Monitoring checks to watch: GPU util, queue depth, router errors, model fallback rate, KV hit %, and end-to-end latency histograms. If fallback rate >1% at peak, escalate.

tom: I'll send Cinder the run window and ask them to stand by. Also to collect 3 golden prompts for quality checks during soak.

asha: Action items:
- luis: run k6 soak + attach logs (owner)
- priya: validate fallback + dashboards, set alert if fallback >0.5% (owner)
- tom: confirm warmup credit + collect golden prompts (owner)
- asha: sign-off on quota priming post-run (owner)

asha: Anything else? Otherwise we go ahead with smoke+soak Mon 23:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
